refnamediv.refpurpose: Query if a Varlink connection object is currently connected, idle, or expected to reply to a method call

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: sd_varlink_is_connected() checks whether the specified Varlink connection object is currently connected or whether it has been fully disconnected already. If link is NULL, the function returns 0, since a non-existent connection is not connected.

sd_varlink_is_idle() checks whether the specified Varlink connection object is currently connected but idle, i.e. may accept a method call for enqueuing (if client side of a Varlink connection) or is waiting for more incoming method calls to arrive (if server side of a Varlink connection).

sd_varlink_wants_reply() checks whether the specified Varlink connection object is currently processing an incoming method call and is expected to send a reply to it, i.e. no final reply or error has been enqueued for it yet, and the method call was not issued with the oneway flag set. This is useful on the server side of a Varlink connection, in particular in method call handlers that invoke helper functions that might or might not have replied to the method call already, for example with an error, before returning. After a call to sd_varlink_reply(), sd_varlink_error() or a related function, this function returns 0. Note that while a method call invoked with the more flag set is processed, this function continues to return a positive value after sd_varlink_notify() has been called, as a final reply is still expected. On the client side of a Varlink connection this function always returns 0. If link is NULL, the function returns 0, since a non-existent connection does not expect a reply.

refsect1.title: Return Value
refsect1.para: If the connection is currently connected sd_varlink_is_connected() returns a positive non-zero value. If disconnected (or if NULL is specified) it returns 0. If the connection currently is idle sd_varlink_is_idle() returns a positive non-zero integer. If not, returns 0. If a reply to the method call currently being processed is expected sd_varlink_wants_reply() returns a positive non-zero integer. If not (or if NULL is specified), it returns 0. On failure, sd_varlink_is_idle() returns a negative errno error code.

refsect2.title: Errors
refsect2.para: Returned errors may indicate the following problems:

listitem.para: The specified Varlink connection is invalid. (Not returned by sd_varlink_is_connected() and sd_varlink_wants_reply().)
